Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that CXC or CX2 has accepted a visible order into the book. It includes a day-unique Order Reference key assigned to the order. The issuing of an Add Order Message is not necessarily always for a new order (see Modification of Existing Orders). Not applicable to CXD.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: Day unique order reference number

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order; S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered because part of the order may trade before being posted to the book).

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the order.

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number or 001 for anonymous.

Message.Name: Long Form Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that CXC or CX2 has accepted a visible order into the book. It includes a day-unique Order Reference key assigned to the order. The issuing of an Add Order Message is not necessarily always for a new order (see Modification of Existing Orders). Not applicable to CXD. Long form messages are used when either the price or size is larger than the standard messages can permit.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: Day unique order reference number

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order; S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered because part of the order may trade before being posted to the book).

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the order. Long form price: 12 whole number places followed by 7 implied decimal digits.

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number or 001 for anonymous.

Message.Name: Order Execution Message
Message.Description: An Order Execution Message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part. Not applicable to CXD.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference key of the order that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed on this trade

Field.Name: Trade Reference
Field.Description: Day unique trade reference number

Field.Name: Contra Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference key of the contra-order that was executed.

Field.Name: Trade Attribute
Field.Description: C = Market On Close

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Contra Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number of the contra order or 001 for anonymous.

Message.Name: Long Form Order Execution Message
Message.Description: An Order Execution Message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part. Not applicable to CXD. Long form messages are used when either the price or size is larger than the standard messages can permit.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference key of the order that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed on this trade

Field.Name: Trade Reference
Field.Description: Day unique trade reference number

Field.Name: Contra Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference key of the contra-order that was executed.

Field.Name: Trade Attribute
Field.Description: C = Market On Close

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Contra Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number of the contra order or 001 for anonymous.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: An Order Cancel Message is sent whenever an order on the book is fully canceled, its quantity revised down or when a pegged order is re-priced. Not applicable to CXD.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being canceled. References a previously sent Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Canceled Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares cancelled

Message.Name: Long Form Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: An Order Cancel Message is sent whenever an order on the book is fully canceled, its quantity revised down or when a pegged order is re-priced. Not applicable to CXD. Long form messages are used when either the price or size is larger than the standard messages can permit.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being canceled. References a previously sent Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Canceled Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares cancelled

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: A Trade Message is sent when a trade occurs against order quantity not visible on the book (i.e. a fully or partially hidden order). They do not affect the book. The Order Reference is always 0 and the Buy/Sell indicator B.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference number of the order executed. (always 0)

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: B = buy order executed; S = sell order executed (Always B)

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Match price of the order

Field.Name: Trade Reference
Field.Description: Trade reference number generated for this trade.

Field.Name: Contra Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference number of the contra order executed.

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number of the buyer or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Contra Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number of the seller or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Trade Attribute
Field.Description: B = Bypass (intentional crosses only); C = CXD Conditional; L = M-ELO; P = CXD PureStream

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: I = Internal; B = Basis; C = Contingent; V = VWAP; X = Intentional Cross; D = Derivative Related; N = Net Asset Value

Field.Name: Settlement Terms
Field.Description: T = Cash Today; D = Delayed Delivery

Message.Name: Long Form Trade Message
Message.Description: A Trade Message is sent when a trade occurs against order quantity not visible on the book (i.e. a fully or partially hidden order). They do not affect the book. The Order Reference is always 0 and the Buy/Sell indicator B. Long form messages are used when either the price or size is larger than the standard messages can permit.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference number of the order executed. (always 0)

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: B = buy order executed; S = sell order executed (Always B)

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Match price of the order. Long form price: 12 whole number places followed by 7 implied decimal digits.

Field.Name: Trade Reference
Field.Description: Trade reference number generated for this trade.

Field.Name: Contra Order Reference
Field.Description: The reference number of the contra order executed.

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number of the buyer or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Contra Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number of the seller or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Trade Attribute
Field.Description: B = Bypass (intentional crosses only); C = CXD Conditional; L = M-ELO; P = CXD PureStream

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: I = Internal; B = Basis; C = Contingent; V = VWAP; X = Intentional Cross; D = Derivative Related; N = Net Asset Value

Field.Name: Settlement Terms
Field.Description: T = Cash Today; D = Delayed Delivery

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: A Broken Trade message is sent whenever an execution is broken. A Broken Trade is final; once a trade is broken it cannot be reinstated.

Field.Name: Trade Reference
Field.Description: The trade reference number of the execution that was broken. This refers to a trade reference number from a previously transmitted Order Execution or Trade Message.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to indicate a market state event.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: System event code, see Event Code values

Message.Name: Stock Status Message
Message.Description: This message indicates the current trading status of a stock. At the start of day, the feed will send out a stock status message for each of the symbols trading on CXC, CX2 and CXD. Subsequently, stock status messages will be sent when a stock is halted or is released for trading.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: H = Halted, T = Trading

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Listing Market
Field.Description: T = TSX, V = Venture, C = CSE, N = Neo

Field.Name: Board Lot Size
Field.Description: Board Lot Size in Shares

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: CAD = Canadian Dollars, USD = US Dollars

Field.Name: GEF Eligible
Field.Description: Y = GEF Eligible, N = Not GEF Eligible

Value.Name: Start of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session
Value.Description: Start of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session

Value.Name: Start of Primary Market Trading Session
Value.Description: Start of Primary Market Trading Session

Value.Name: End of Primary Market Trading Session
Value.Description: End of Primary Market Trading Session. Indicates that Pegged orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: End of System Hours. Nasdaq Canada is closed and not accepting orders. It is still possible to receive Broken Trade messages and Order Cancel Messages.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. Last message of the day.

Value.Name: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt
Value.Description: Trading Halted due to Market-Wide Circuit Breaker

Value.Name: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Resumption
Value.Description: Trading Resumed following Market-Wide Circuit Breaker

Value.Name: Market On Close or CXD Conditional
Value.Description: Market On Close on the Order Execution Message; CXD Conditional on the Trade Message
